title: The tangent planes of V are exactly the approximate tangent planes of (M, θ) (Ch. 3, Def. 1.7)
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N, M ⊆ ℝ^N H^n-null-measurable, θ : ℝ^N → ℝ with θ > 0 on M, θ H^n-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U, and μ_V(B) = ∫_{B ∩ M} θ dH^n for every Borel B. If HasTangentPlane V x T (θ(x)), then for every S ∈ G(N,n): M has approximate tangent space S.plane at x with respect to θ in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.7 (Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x S.plane) if and only if S = T.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n), NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n] → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 < θ y) → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) μHE[n]) → (∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → V.weight B = ∫⁻ y in B ∩ M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) ∂μHE[n]) → HasTangentPlane V x T (θ x) → ∀ S : Grassmannian N n, Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x S.plane ↔ S = T
